title: When is the cleanest, and the cheapest, time to use electricity? Carbon intensity, prices and load shifting on the GB grid, 2019–2025 (code, results and working paper)
description:
Code, processed results and working paper (draft v0.3) for a study of when electricity use in Great Britain is cleanest and cheapest, 2019–2025.

Using public half-hourly data (NESO Carbon Intensity API; Elexon FUELHH generation and MID wholesale prices; Octopus Agile household prices), the study measures how the daily shape of carbon intensity and prices has changed, simulates flexible demand under fixed, forecast-based and price-based schedules (testing fixed rules out of sample), compares carbon and cost savings on the same days, and estimates the implied abatement cost of carbon-aware over cheapest scheduling. Marginal emission factors are estimated as a robustness check.

The analysis can be reproduced with four commands; see README.md.
